title: Finding a unit and holding it

cues.text: Read the mall plan, open a unit to see its size and list rent, and hold it for a brand you are talking to.
Units and plan shows every shop in the mall, on the plan and as a list.
At the top: how many units are available, on hold, reserved and leased, with their area.
On the plan, each colour is a status, so free space stands out at a glance.
Hover a shop to see its code, status and size.
Click a shop on the plan or in the list to open it.
The unit page shows its status, indoor area and terrace, and the list rent a month and a year.
Where it is marks the shop on the plan, and below are its documents, work orders, interested leads and offers.
To keep it for a brand while you negotiate, choose the lead under Hold this unit.
Set how many days. The hold ends by itself, so units never stay blocked by mistake.
The unit is now on hold for that brand, on the plan and for everyone in the office.
